title: Lt. Samuel A. Miller and William E. Miller — servicemen photo
text: LT. SAMUEL A. MILLER (left) has landed somewhere in France, according to word received by his mother, Mrs. Fay Miller of Savoy. On a pilot observation plane in the AAF, he entered service in 1939, received his commission in 1943, and received his wings at Pittsburgh. His wife and two children reside in Lawton, Okla. A brother, William E. Miller (right) seaso[?] first class, is on a LST and, with his crew, has been cited for bravery. He helped land the first troops on Gua[?] and at Antane in New Guinea.
